searchText: From https://notes.ethereum.org/EbCbXn_BTuuUYqOaLE3iGA?view > 113. WWIII: A key design goal is to survive WWIII. ^^^^ ???? Oh https://blog.ethereum.org/2019/11/27/Validated-Staking-on-eth2-0/ Represents remaining useful and live through a time of potentially major and sustained network partitions, high latencies, etc **JonnyRhea** (in reply to **<@456226577798135808>**) some dumbass wrote this awhile back ... might be useful: https://ethresear.ch/t/explaining-the-liveness-guarantee/4228 Does anyone know why the quorum for justification is `>= 2/3` instead of `> 2/3`? The only reference i can find to `>= 2/3` is the casper ffg paper (but doesn't explain how/why), and most other papers i've seen on bft are strictly bound at `> 2/3` **alex_vlasoff** For example, if two conflicting epochs (of the same height) have been justified, it means >= 1/3 of validators voted twice. If the amount of such faulty validators < 1/3, than such a violation is not possible. **alex_vlasoff** So, `>= 2/3` is a rule and `< 1/3` is a safety threshold, slightly different concepts. **alex_vlasoff** If the rule were `>= 3/5` then two conflicting epochs justified means `>= 1/5` validators voted twice. So a safety threshold would be `< 1/5`.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content: Does anyone know why the quorum for justification is `>= 2/3` instead of `> 2/3`? The only reference i can find to `>= 2/3` is the casper ffg paper (but doesn't explain how/why), and most other papers i've seen on bft are strictly bound at `> 2/3`

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**alex_vlasoff**
For example, if two conflicting epochs (of the same height) have been justified, it means >= 1/3 of validators voted twice. If the amount of such faulty validators < 1/3, than such a violation is not possible.

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**alex_vlasoff**
So, `>= 2/3` is a rule and `< 1/3` is a safety threshold, slightly different concepts.

excerpts.author: eth2_bridge_bot
excerpts.content:
**alex_vlasoff**
If the rule were `>= 3/5` then two conflicting epochs justified means `>= 1/5` validators voted twice. So a safety threshold would be `< 1/5`.
